intent: Implement EvoPilot v4.0.0 as an open declarative Lifecycle Harness platform with human-readable YAML, schema-driven conversational parameter collection, risk-tiered approval minimization, automatic deterministic stages, immutable published HarnessBundle binding, Agent-runtime-neutral execution, and DataRig enterprise-internal plus evopilot-harness open-source reference lifecycles.
objective: Let different software and goal types select, resolve, configure, and execute a safe versioned lifecycle without project-specific Engine branches, while asking ordinary users only for unresolved inputs, minimizing human decisions to genuine authority or risk boundaries, and preserving the independent evopilot-harness Asset lifecycle.

evidence.authority: explicit user Roadmap direction and request to begin governed implementation; not approval of this Target revision or release
explicit user design requirement; not Target or release authority
explicit user approval of revision 1 for implementation with release withheld; revision 1 subsequently failed the mandatory inheritance contract and cannot authorize changed revision 2
explicit approval of the exact Roadmap version-line transition only; it does not approve Target revision 3, implementation, Candidate formation, acceptance, or release
verified Roadmap transition evidence binding v3.2 DEFERRED inheritance into the current v4.0 IN_PROGRESS line; not Target or release authority
Codex navigation evidence requiring the installed Suite evolution lifecycle, EvoPilot product Lifecycle Harness, and product reference lifecycles to remain separate; not product authority
public open-source lifecycle and immutable Harness producer contract evidence only
external declarative input and registered-action design evidence only
external declarative run, retry, and final-task evidence only
external resource schema and spec/status separation evidence only

include: Define and validate LifecycleDefinition, LifecycleRevision, LifecycleCatalog, LifecycleResolver, LifecycleInputBinding, LifecycleBinding, and LifecycleRun v1alpha1 contracts
Parse human-readable YAML and resolve imports into a canonical immutable graph with explicit schema, resource, cycle, condition, and compatibility limits
Build a closed versioned Action and Capability Registry and reject arbitrary executable code or unsupported capabilities in Lifecycle YAML
Separate editable Lifecycle specification from append-only runtime status, attempts, receipts, evidence, decisions, and results
Define typed input schemas with prompt, description, required/default, options, validation, conditional visibility, source precedence, derivation, sensitivity, review, and SecretRef behavior
Resolve project facts, Organization defaults, lifecycle defaults, runtime capabilities, deterministic values, user answers, and SecretRefs into an immutable provenance-bearing LifecycleInputBinding
Generate one-question-at-a-time ordinary-human interaction and a final review from the same schema used by UI, MCP, CLI, API, and CI
Support headless YAML or JSON parameter submission without semantic drift from conversational collection
Implement AUTO, POLICY, HUMAN, EXTERNAL_SIGNAL, and DISABLED decision modes
Automatically run deterministic reversible validation, readiness, build, test, smoke, evaluation, evidence capture, aggregation, safe resume, and safe identical-input retry within authorized scope
Implement bounded digest-bound plan authorization so unchanged automatic stages do not require repeated human approval

Require explicit digest-bound human decisions only at missing authority, irreversible or external effects, production or credential authority, project release/publication, exceptions, ambiguity, unresolved risk, or uncertain mutation
Bind every run to exact lifecycle, input, policy, action, HarnessBundle, runtime, project, Goal/Target, and evidence digests and fail relevant drift closed
Integrate external Agent runtimes through versioned ExecutorAdapter contracts and expose a host-neutral EvoPilot MCP interaction surface
Prove that MCP, direct API/SDK, CLI, and CI transports share Engine semantics and cannot infer authority
Create a DataRig enterprise-internal delivery reference lifecycle with every repository-specific constant represented as discovered or declared input
Create an evopilot-harness public open-source release reference lifecycle with its genuine publication authority boundaries and no project-name Engine branch
Create an Alpha/Beta/RC/GA v3 compatibility lifecycle and a documented, evidence-preserving migration and rollback path
Add AgentTrajectory, Outcome/Process/Safety/Cost RewardContract, governed private dataset, and approved redacted HarnessExecutionFeedbackPackage foundations
Synchronize architecture, schema, API, CLI, MCP, migration, reference-profile, operating, security, and acceptance documentation
exclude: Harness Asset reasoning, authoring, evolution, review, approval, evaluation, publication, Catalog, or Registry mutation in EvoPilot
Goal Loop or project release execution inside evopilot-harness
Embedding DataRig or evopilot-harness paths, credentials, environments, approvers, commands, channels, package coordinates, or repository names as privileged Engine behavior
Arbitrary shell, JavaScript, Python, unbounded expressions, or hidden executable prompts inside Lifecycle YAML
Raw secret collection or persistence in conversation, Lifecycle YAML, input bindings, evidence, or logs
Treating parameter entry, readiness, acknowledgement, generic continuation, validation success, or Agent recommendation as approval
Per-stage human approval where an unchanged bounded authorization and automatic policy already applies
Automatic production access, credential authority expansion, project release, publication, policy exception, or recovery from an uncertain mutation
Exclusive dependency on WorkBuddy, Codex, OpenCode, one MCP client, one Agent runtime, or one model provider
Embedded general-purpose Agent session/tool-loop/runtime or model-training implementation
Changing or republishing evopilot-harness v4.5.0 artifacts, Target, acceptance, or release
Changing the current EvoPilot v3.2.0 Bundle Consumer Closure scope or declaring v4.0.0 release authority
Commit, push, tag, package publication, deployment, or GitHub Release

designDecisions.ownership: EvoPilot project-execution Lifecycle Harness; evopilot-harness Asset lifecycle unchanged
designDecisions.definitionModel: open declarative graph over closed versioned actions and capabilities
designDecisions.configuration: human-readable YAML with one schema for conversational and headless entry
designDecisions.inputAuthority: parameter collection is non-authorizing and produces an immutable provenance-bearing binding
designDecisions.secretPolicy: SecretRef only; raw secrets forbidden in definitions, conversation, bindings, and evidence
designDecisions.automationDefault: deterministic reversible work inside unchanged authorized scope is automatic
designDecisions.humanGatePolicy: only genuine authority, external-effect, production, release/publication, exception, ambiguity, risk, or uncertain-mutation boundaries
designDecisions.authorizationEconomy: one digest-bound decision may authorize an unchanged bounded plan and all declared automatic stages
designDecisions.runtimeModel: Agent-runtime-neutral external execution behind versioned adapters
designDecisions.agentHostModel: MCP is the normal conversational transport; Engine APIs remain authoritative and direct automation remains supported
designDecisions.referenceModel: DataRig and evopilot-harness are data-driven examples and conformance cases, never Engine branches
designDecisions.compatibility: Alpha/Beta/RC/GA remains an explicit v3 compatibility profile with evidence-preserving migration
designDecisions.version: EvoPilot 4.0.0 major; evopilot-harness version remains independent

realCaseCoverage.startingState: fresh EvoPilot v4 Workspace, read-only DataRig checkout, published HarnessBundle, no LifecycleRun
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: validated internal-release-ready LifecycleRun with publication not executed
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Candidate-package real-case transcript, input provenance, decision inventory, automatic-stage receipts, run binding digest, and no-project-branch scan

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run the evopilot-harness public open-source lifecycle from a fresh exact source and published Bundle through conversational configuration, deterministic checks, package-ready evidence, and a separate unexecuted publication decision.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: fresh EvoPilot v4 Workspace, immutable evopilot-harness source revision and Bundle, no LifecycleRun
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: validated public-release-ready LifecycleRun stopped before publication
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Candidate-package cross-host semantic evidence, exact bindings, approval-minimization trace, boundary sentinels, and package-ready report

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Author and execute a third materially different documentation or security-hotfix Lifecycle YAML using only registered capabilities and no Engine source change.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: fresh EvoPilot v4 Workspace with registered actions but no custom lifecycle
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: completed custom LifecycleRun with equivalent conversational and headless result digests
prohibitedEffects: Engine source modification for the new lifecycle
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Custom YAML, schema and graph validation, Engine source diff proof, cross-transport result equivalence, and hostile YAML negatives

realCaseCoverage.terminalState: v4 compatibility LifecycleBinding with equivalent evidence and authority plus verified rollback
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Before/after digests, migration and rollback receipts, authority equivalence assertions, and complete v3 regression replay

acceptance.criterion: Roadmap, ADR, AGENTS, machine contract, and intent/release Gates consistently declare EvoPilot v4.0.0 Open Lifecycle Harness while leaving v3.2.0 closure unchanged.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Roadmap digest, Gate tests, architecture docs, and diff review

acceptance.criterion: Lifecycle resource schemas accept valid human-readable YAML, reject unknown or unsafe fields, canonicalize deterministically, detect missing imports and cycles, and produce stable immutable revision digests.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema fixtures, canonicalization goldens, graph positive/negative tests, and digest replay

acceptance.criterion: Lifecycle YAML can reference only registered versioned actions and capabilities and cannot embed arbitrary executable code or bypass runtime policy.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Action registry contract tests, hostile YAML corpus, and architecture guard

acceptance.criterion: One input schema generates equivalent conversational, UI/MCP, CLI/API, and CI validation semantics, asks only unresolved conditionally relevant fields, presents defaults and provenance, and ends with a reviewable immutable input binding.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-surface golden fixtures and semantic equivalence tests

acceptance.criterion: Input collection never advances an authority decision, and raw secrets are rejected or redacted while SecretRef bindings remain usable and auditable.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Authority negative tests, secret scans, redaction tests, and credential-reference E2E

acceptance.criterion: Deterministic reversible stages execute automatically inside an unchanged authorized plan without per-stage approval, including validation, readiness, build, test, smoke, evaluation, evidence capture, aggregation, and safe resume.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Automatic continuation matrix, event log, and no-human-gate assertions

acceptance.criterion: HUMAN gates appear only for declared genuine authority or risk boundaries, explain the exact object and consequence, bind the current digest, and cannot be satisfied by generic conversation, acknowledgement, readiness, input, or Agent recommendation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Decision-justification lint, positive authority tests, and hostile interaction matrix

acceptance.criterion: One bounded authorization covers unchanged declared automatic stages; only relevant binding drift invalidates the affected decision, while unrelated Catalog growth or status changes do not cause repeated approval.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Authorization coverage, selective drift, and non-drift regression tests

acceptance.criterion: Retries and resumes are idempotent and automatic only when receipts prove no uncertain mutation; unknown external outcomes stop at an explicit recovery decision.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Crash, timeout, duplicate, receipt, and uncertain-mutation failure matrix

acceptance.criterion: Every run binds exact lifecycle, input, policy, action, HarnessBundle, runtime, project, Goal/Target, and evidence digests; relevant drift fails closed without silently switching lifecycle or Harness.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Binding closure tests, tamper matrix, and immutable replay

acceptance.criterion: DataRig enterprise-internal delivery completes through a generic reference definition with interactive unresolved inputs and maximum safe automation, without a DataRig-named Engine branch or embedded constants.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh real-case E2E, hard-code scan, parameter provenance, decision count, and evidence closure

acceptance.criterion: evopilot-harness public open-source release completes through a generic reference definition that preserves immutable Bundle and genuine publication authority without a repository-named Engine branch or changes to v4.5.0.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Isolated non-publishing E2E through release-ready state, hard-code scan, and boundary assertions

acceptance.criterion: A third lifecycle materially different from both references is authored as YAML and runs without Engine changes, proving the extension model is open rather than two hard-coded cases.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent lifecycle fixture, unchanged Engine digest or source diff, and full E2E

acceptance.criterion: Alpha/Beta/RC/GA v3 plans remain readable and migrate to an explicit compatibility lifecycle without loss or silent reinterpretation of evidence, approvals, or release state.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Migration fixtures, rollback, before/after evidence comparison, and legacy regression suite

acceptance.criterion: WorkBuddy, Codex, and one independent conformant host use the same MCP interaction semantics, while a direct API/CLI headless run reaches an equivalent authoritative result.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-host and direct-transport conformance matrix with exact Engine object digests

acceptance.criterion: Agent runtime adapters bind exact capabilities, model/provider, request/result, cost, trajectory, artifacts, and resumable receipts; an unsupported or hostile runtime cannot bypass action, sandbox, evidence, or authority policy.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: OpenCode plus independent-adapter conformance, hostile adapter tests, and trajectory closure

acceptance.criterion: EvoPilot remains a read-only immutable HarnessBundle consumer, evopilot-harness remains the producer, and feedback export is redacted, approved, immutable, and non-mutating.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Architecture verification, Catalog filesystem sentinels, consumer tests, and feedback negative cases

acceptance.criterion: Security, resource, concurrency, cancellation, observability, audit, tenant/workspace isolation, failure recovery, performance, documentation, packaging, and no-regression checks pass before candidate acceptance.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Full check suite, threat-model tests, soak/performance report, docs verification, and release-artifact dry run
